feature: Search tours by place: current location, address or dropped pin
notes: Built: address search on Enter (Nominatim) and Use my location. Missing: dropped pin. Verified by check-discover.js

feature: Search state lives in the URL: place, centre point, sport, max distance, page
notes: Built on /?page=planner&...: place, centre, radius, sport, theme, difficulty, max length. No page (there is no pagination). Restores on load

feature: Filter by sport
notes: Single-choice Walk, Hike, Cycle, Run. The seed has no run routes, so Run is empty. Naarad's old chips were themes: those are a separate Theme filter now

feature: Filter by maximum distance
notes: Both readings built, since the recon could not confirm which one Komoot means: Longest route (length cap) and Within (radius from the place)

feature: Filter by difficulty: easy, intermediate, expert, colour coded
notes: Easy, Moderate, Hard chips, several at once. The 9 real tracks have no difficulty, so a difficulty filter excludes them

feature: Filter by duration range, 30 minutes to 10 hours
notes: Source: help summary. routes.json has duration_min

feature: Filter by elevation gain range
notes: Source: help summary. routes.json has one elevation_m, meaning of the number unconfirmed

feature: Filter by surface: no preference, paved, off-road
notes: Source: help summary. No surface field in Naarad's data

feature: Filter by route type: loop or out and back
notes: Source: press summary. No such field in Naarad's data

feature: Results as cards with key stats
notes: Cards show only what is known: distance, time, ascent, difficulty, rating. Tracks have distance only

feature: Result count
notes: Live status line: N routes, or N routes within X km of the place

feature: Paginated results
notes: Source: pageNumber in the URL. Only worth it with more than a few dozen routes. Naarad has about 20 (12 curated, 9 unique tracks)

feature: Ranked or personalised recommendation order
notes: Needs their user data. Use a plain relevance order (distance from the centre, then rating) instead

feature: Split view: list and map side by side
notes: List column beside the map at 900px and up, results sheet over the map below it

feature: Tour lines on the map coloured by difficulty
notes: Built: colour and dash per difficulty. But only the 9 real tracks have a line and none has a difficulty, so today they are drawn in the neutral colour

feature: Animated direction markers on tour lines
notes: Source: press summary

feature: Labelled start points on the map
notes: Built: start markers ringed in the difficulty colour. Not built: text labels

feature: Map view can be switched on or off
notes: Source: only the map=true URL parameter. Unconfirmed that there is a control

feature: Tour detail page: map, distance, duration, elevation, difficulty, description
notes: Not built as S04. The 6 curated routes that have a route page get an Open route page button. Tracks and the other 6 have no page

feature: Highlights on the map: points and segments with photos and tips
notes: Source: help summary. Closest in Naarad: waypoints and audio stops

feature: Create a Highlight: pin, name, sport, tip, photos
notes: Source: help summary. Closest in Naarad: the Creator audio annotations

feature: Rate Highlights after an activity and add a tip or photo
notes: Source: help summary. Needs activity recording, so depends on a feature outside this slice

feature: Plan a route on the web from waypoints
notes: Naarad's Plan mode, untouched by the rebuild. Tested: add, remove, clear, export all work (F06). Two open bugs: BUG-006 (the empty list says click the map, but a button press is needed first), BUG-007 (its search box does nothing).

feature: Add a waypoint by clicking the map, auto-placed in the best position
notes: A click adds a waypoint at the end of the list, one per press of the Add button. It is never re-ordered into the best position (F06-H1, BUG-006).

feature: Add Highlights and places of interest as waypoints
notes: Source: help summary

feature: Import GPX, TCX or FIT
notes: Source: help summary. Naarad only has an offline build script (convert-gpx.js), not a user feature

feature: Export a route as GPX (line only, no waypoints)
notes: Plan mode exports the route you draw as GPX: waypoints and a track (test F06-H1). A route found in Discover cannot be exported.

feature: Plan multi-day routes as stages
notes: Source: help summary. A Premium feature in the original

feature: Offline maps for chosen regions
notes: Source: help summary. Naarad's pricing.json and routes.json claim offline, implementation not audited

feature: Community network of millions of tours and user Highlights
notes: The network and its content are not a feature you can rebuild. Seed with Naarad's own routes

feature: Heatmaps
notes: Aggregate data they own

feature: 3D maps, live tracking, weather on route
notes: Outside the Discover slice

feature: Turn-by-turn navigation and activity recording
notes: A separate project, outside the Discover slice

feature: Garmin and watch sync
notes: Partner integrations, not part of the product you can rebuild

feature: One free region, then Maps or Premium purchase
notes: Naarad has its own pricing model (data/pricing.json)

feature: Filter by theme: heritage walk, temple trail, nature hike, cultural tour, coastal walk, photography
notes: Naarad's own route types. Several at once. Added in the rebuild

feature: Open the full route page from a result card (story, map and tabs)
notes: 6 of the 12 curated routes have a page. Reuses the pages Naarad already had
